subject: Status: compression curves ahead of the 4/17 gate
body:
Hi both,

Curves land on time. Headline: on the flagship ranking model, low-rank compression via ApplyCompression reaches 4x weight reduction at 0.4% metric loss when the ops run during training; the same ratio applied post-training costs 2.1%. That delta is the whole argument for the in-graph approach, so it goes on slide one.

Smoothed compression matters more than expected: ramping the compression fraction over the first third of training avoids the loss cliff we saw with an abrupt schedule. Linnea has the schedule hyperparameters documented in the shared config.

Risk: the embedding tables dominate memory but tolerate compression worst - past 2x, retrieval recall drops fast. Recommendation will likely be tiered: 4x on dense layers, 2x on embeddings. Also flagging that our second target model still runs TF1-style sessions and the CompressionOpInterface wiring there is fiddly; Emeka lost a week to it.

Yusuf
